4.3 Proof of the correctness of algorithms
The use of cryptographically bound, non-transferable identification tokens, as illustrated 
in Algorithm 1, is integral to the system. The registration process incorporates protec -
tions to ensure the security of personal information while confirming identity. No one 
can deny or alter a registered identity because of the immutability of the blockchain. 
Consistent enforcement of registration rules across all participants is ensured by smart 
contracts. Each user is able to access the precise data that was initially uploaded, as 
shown in Algorithm 2. The data is protected so that only authorised people can access it. 
The integrity of the obtained data is confirmed by comparing it with IPFS hashes. Addi -
tionally, this algorithm completes its execution in a finite number of steps. Deciphering 
the ciphertext with the right parameters and key returns the original plaintext, as dem -
onstrated in Algorithm 3. Hash functions on the Blockchain and IPFS CID ensure that 
data remains secure during storage and transaction.
5 Result analysis
We have conducted a number of experiments on various machines in the same network 
to evaluate the performance of our proposed framework. Using content-addressed hash-
ing, the platform facilitates efficient distributed healthcare data storage, access, and 
retrieval. This architecture is user-friendly and effective at preserving the confidential -
ity, availability, and integrity of sensitive healthcare information. We employed seven 
distinct healthcare file sizes across multiple machines to test the proposed framework. 
Tests of the framework’s performance were conducted using the metrics of upload, 
download, access, and mining times.
  – Upload Time: Upload time is the time a node takes to upload new transactions to the 
Blockchain network. Upload time depends on network speed and node processing 
power.
  – Download Time: Blockchain download time is the time it takes a node to download 
the file and synchronize with the whole network. Blockchain size, network speed, 
and node processing power determine download time.
  – Access Time: Blockchain access time is the time it takes a user to access a transaction 
or block. It varies depending on the Blockchain’s size and the user’s device’s 
computational power.
  – Mining Time:  Blockchain mining time is the time it takes miners to solve 
cryptographic puzzles and add new blocks or transactions. Puzzle difficulty and 
miner node processing speed affect mining time. Network protocol determines block 
time, which differs from each Blockchain.
We’ve considered healthcare files of varying sizes, uploaded them from several machines, 
and timed how long each file took to be added to Blockchain and IPFS. Figure 5. displays 
the difference in upload speed between IPFS and Blockchain. Observation indicates that 
the time required to upload files to the Blockchain network increases with file size. The 
graph in Fig.  5. indicates that IPFS uploads faster than Blockchain. The time it takes to

resposta.resumo: O estudo apresenta um framework que integra blockchain e IPFS para armazenamento, acesso e compartilhamento seguro de dados de saúde em cidades inteligentes, usando tokens de identidade não transferíveis e smart contracts para controle de acesso, e avalia desempenho (tempo de upload, download, acesso e mineração) em diferentes tamanhos de arquivos.

perfil.solucao: Algorithm 3 Algorithm for Encrypting and Decrypting Healthcare Data

perfil.possibilidades: Avaliar latência e throughput de recuperação de dados via IPFS em cenários de borda; integrar identidade auto‑soberana (SSI) para autenticar dispositivos antes do acesso ao IPFS; comparar o esquema de criptografia do Algoritmo 3 com técnicas pós‑quânticas; analisar a escalabilidade do modelo quando múltiplas cidades inteligentes compartilham dados simultaneamente; investigar o impacto de diferentes protocolos de rede na mineração e no tempo de acesso; explorar ajustes dinâmicos de tamanho de bloco para suportar fluxos heterogêneos de IoT.

evidencias.afirmacao: Tokens de identificação não transferíveis garantem a imutabilidade da identidade na blockchain.
evidencias.citacao: "No one can deny or alter a registered identity because of the immutability of the blockchain."

evidencias.afirmacao: O IPFS apresenta tempo de upload menos sensível ao aumento de tamanho de arquivo comparado ao blockchain.
evidencias.citacao: "The graph in Fig. 5 indicates that IPFS uploads faster than Blockchain... after a certain file size, it increases minimally, much faster than uploading to Blockchain."

resposta.interpretacao: O trabalho demonstra que a combinação de blockchain e IPFS permite controle de acesso seguro e integridade dos dados de saúde, porém o desempenho de upload e download varia conforme o tamanho dos arquivos e a infraestrutura de rede, destacando a vantagem do IPFS para arquivos maiores.
resposta.duvidas: Como o modelo se comporta em redes de borda heterogêneas? Qual o impacto da dificuldade de mineração sobre a latência de acesso ao dado? Há avaliação dos riscos de privacidade associados aos metadados armazenados no IPFS?
